questions.q: Why is Data Cloud needed for the renewal-risk question?
options: Opportunity records show what was sold but not whether the product is actually used
CRM Analytics cannot display renewals
Salesforce does not store renewal dates
Data Cloud is required to draw bar charts
questions.explain: Adoption evidence lives in product usage data outside Salesforce CRM. Data Cloud brings it in so it can sit beside opportunity and renewal data.

questions.q: Why is identity resolution not needed in this capstone's usage stream?
options: Identity resolution only works on opportunities
Both sources carry the same Salesforce Account ID, so the join is exact
Usage data never contains accounts
Identity resolution is disabled in all orgs
questions.explain: Identity resolution matters when sources share no reliable key. With a shared Account ID, a direct join is simpler and exact.

questions.q: Why should Seat Activation use the latest snapshot per account instead of summing across daily rows?
options: Because daily rows are always deleted
Because Data Cloud cannot store more than one row per account
Summing daily snapshots multiplies both numerator and denominator and produces meaningless results
Because the latest snapshot is always 100 percent
questions.explain: Each daily row already represents a state. Adding them together inflates both sides by the number of days and breaks the ratio's meaning.

questions.q: What is the correct refresh order for the capstone's chain?
options: Recipe, dashboard, stream, insight
Dashboard, recipe, insight, stream
Insight, recipe, stream, dashboard
Stream, calculated insight, recipe, dashboard
questions.explain: Each step depends on the one before it. If the recipe runs before the insight refreshes, the dashboard silently shows stale usage.

questions.q: In the example, 17 of 96 renewing accounts hold $2.3M of the $12.4M renewing. Which statement is correct?
options: Those accounts hold about 50% of renewing ARR
Those accounts hold about 19% of renewing ARR
Those accounts hold about 2% of renewing ARR
Those accounts hold all of the renewing ARR
questions.explain: $2.3M divided by $12.4M is about 18.5%, roughly 19%. A small share of accounts, but a meaningful share of revenue worth acting on.
